metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T003 cutover-readiness rehearsal. T003 consumes only the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source produced by T010 from the exact terminal T009 merge-commit tree; it does not materialize source from, read, or require authority over /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git, mutable Heim-PC checkouts, moving branches or main itself. Reconstruction and boot consume the T010 artifact manifest-bound T009 merge commit/tree, predecessor ancestry, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. The sandbox may expose a blank virtual block device and disposable restore scratch only after fresh evidence proves its backing is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, any mounted production filesystem, or production EFI/firmware state. Independent off-host backup material may be consumed read-only for restore testing but grants no production-device write authority.
